title: The Rhythm of School Street
logline: When the town's crossing signals begin to fail in a hidden mathematical sequence, an eight-year-old autistic girl must use her unique ability to read patterns to prevent a major traffic accident at the school crossing.

beats.title: The Sound Collector
beats.summary: Aanya sits in the park, trying to capture the perfect, uninterrupted sixty-second audio loop of the historic water fountain for her private sound library.
beats.trait_in_play: Aanya's autistic focus and appreciation for steady, repeating sensory rhythms drive her personal quest to record the fountain.

beats.title: The First Glitch
beats.summary: A sharp, off-beat click from the nearby Oak Street crossing signal ruins Aanya's recording, but her pattern-seeking brain immediately logs the irregular stutter.
beats.trait_in_play: She notices a subtle variation in the signal's audio-visual sequence that any non-disabled observer would ignore.

beats.title: Mapping the Decay
beats.summary: On her walk home, Aanya observes the Maple Street crossing signal. It stutters in a different but mathematically related sequence, confirming a decaying pattern.
beats.trait_in_play: She translates the blinking lights into a numerical sequence, mapping the town's grid like a giant puzzle.

beats.title: The Classroom Equation
beats.summary: During math class, Aanya tries to show her teacher, Mr. Harrison, her grid of the decaying signals, but he dismisses it as a simple loose lightbulb.
beats.trait_in_play: She expresses herself with direct honesty, focusing entirely on the logical reality of the pattern rather than social expectations.

beats.title: The Next Coordinate
beats.summary: Aanya calculates that the decay is accelerating. The final, complete failure of the system will occur at the busiest intersection: School Street.
beats.trait_in_play: Her relentless drive to solve the puzzle helps her calculate the exact time of the impending system failure.

beats.title: The Ignored Warning
beats.summary: Aanya visits the Town Maintenance Office to warn Mr. Miller, the clerk. He tells her she is overthinking and should run along and play like a normal kid.
beats.trait_in_play: Despite the social frustration of being misunderstood, her strong moral compass keeps her focused on the safety of others.

beats.title: The Safe Space
beats.summary: Back in her room, Aanya uses her smooth gray pebble to self-regulate. She realizes she does not need to change who she is; she just needs to make the danger visible.
beats.trait_in_play: She uses her totem and her quiet environment to process her feelings and plan her next logical steps.

beats.title: Preparing the Grid
beats.summary: Aanya packs her backpack with high-visibility blue tape and her audio recorder, preparing to create a physical safety grid at the School Street crossing.
beats.trait_in_play: She uses her systematic planning and visual-spatial strengths to design a real-world safety backup.

beats.title: The Chaos of School Street
beats.summary: At 8:10 AM, School Street is a loud, overwhelming mess. Aanya puts on her noise-reducing headphones to stay grounded as she lays down her tape.
beats.trait_in_play: She manages her sensory vulnerability with her headphones, maintaining absolute focus on her mission.

beats.title: The Sudden Silence
beats.summary: At exactly 8:15 AM, the School Street crossing light goes completely black just as a group of children steps off the curb and a truck approaches.
beats.trait_in_play: Her prediction is proven perfectly accurate to the second, validating her unique way of seeing the world.

beats.title: The Rhythmic Rescue
beats.summary: Aanya plays her recorded, perfectly timed crossing signal audio through her speaker, halting the children and alerting the truck just in time.
beats.trait_in_play: She solves a high-stakes, real-world crisis using the exact audio patterns she has cataloged.

beats.title: The Perfect Loop
beats.summary: The town repairs the signals. Aanya returns to the park and finally records her perfect, uninterrupted fountain loop, proud of who she is.
beats.trait_in_play: She remains her authentic, autistic self, enjoying her successful recording and turning her pebble.

trait_causality_note: Aanya's autistic pattern-recognition allows her to identify the mathematical decay sequence of the crossing signals and predict the exact time and location of the final crash before any adult notices.
